purpose: Use the verified Astra research/evidence-extraction path to attack the current terminal frontier after V7 layered distributional equal-or-better semantics. Seek decisive counterexamples or source-bound support for evaluator completeness, admissible-context completeness, and target utility-quotient completeness without weakening the terminal objective or granting self-certified credit.

goal.objective: Determine the smallest truthful current residual for terminal completeness after V7. Falsify or support, in this order: (1) completeness of all capability-relevant terminal evaluators and hard constraints for useful Opus 5.5 behavior, (2) completeness of the admissible external-context domain, and (3) completeness of the target utility quotient. Search canonical Brain evidence first, then provenance-bound external primary sources where useful. Prefer constructive counterexamples over supportive prose. For every surviving claim, return exact source-bound evidence and the strongest falsifier attempted. If any claim fails, isolate the minimal missing evaluator, context class, utility distinction, or quotient class. Do not claim current Brain dominance, ownership closure, composition closure, or terminal success.
constraints: do not weaken the terminal objective
do not treat Astra statements as evidence without provenance
prefer primary sources and exact canonical artifacts
counterexample search has priority over confirmation
no terminal, acceptance, family, capability, or ownership credit from this mission alone
success_evidence: candidate completeness definitions or scope bindings
source-bound evidence for every factual premise
minimal residual or decisive falsifier for each of the three ordered completeness claims
explicit UNKNOWN where evidence is insufficient
durable content-addressable receipt suitable for independent verification
